views.text: In July 2021, Equity Mates described Ramsay Health Care as Australia's biggest hospital operator, valued at about $14 billion, with 72 hospitals and sites of care, highlighting the scale of its private healthcare services.

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In July 2022, Equity Mates noted Macquarie included Ramsay Health Care among Australian healthcare stocks seen as recession-proof, implying the sector's resilience in downturns.

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In March 2021, a guest on Equity Mates said Ramsay Health Care had cut its dividend recently, contrasting it with a company that had not cut dividends in 20 years.

steps.q: Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In April 2022, Equity Mates covered a KKR bid for Ramsay Health Care at $88 a share when it traded near $64, noting a 24 percent jump and the Ramsay Foundation’s reported 20 percent support.
